display_fil: Hugasan ng sabon at tubig → iulat agad → agarang medical evaluation. Huwag hintayin ang sintomas.
display_en: Wash with soap and water → report immediately → immediate medical evaluation. Do not wait for symptoms.
narration_fil:
Si BHW Apple ay nasa kunwaring safety practice. Kathang-isip ang sitwasyon at bagong adaptasyon ang usapan, hindi sipi sa DOH. Walang tunay na karayom, sugat o body fluid sa pagsasanay. Sabi ng trainer, “Ipagpalagay na natusok ka ng ginamit na karayom. Wala kang sintomas. Ano ang gagawin mo?”

Sagot ni Apple, “Huhugasan ko ng sabon at tubig, mag-uulat agad at kukuha kaagad ng medical evaluation.” Sa tunay na needlestick, hugasan ang sugat gamit ang sabon at tubig. Iulat agad sa nakatalagang supervisor o contact ayon sa lokal na proseso at kumuha kaagad ng pagsusuri sa kwalipikadong medical provider. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang. Huwag hintayin ang sintomas, pagtatapos ng visits o uwian. Hindi patunay ng kaligtasan ang kawalan ng sintomas.

Ang kwalipikadong provider ang magpapasya sa assessment at anumang paggamot. Huwag pumili ng gamot mula sa supplies. Sa simulation, sabihin at ituro ang reporting at evaluation pathway; walang tunay na pagtusok o paglalagay ng gamot.
narration_en:
BHW Apple is in a simulated safety practice. The situation is fictional and the dialogue is a new adaptation, not a DOH quotation. Practice uses no real needle, wound or body fluid. The trainer says, “Imagine a used-needle injury. You have no symptoms. What will you do?”

Apple answers, “I will wash with soap and water, report immediately and obtain immediate medical evaluation.” After an actual needlestick, wash the wound with soap and water. Report immediately to the designated supervisor or contact through the local process and obtain immediate evaluation by a qualified medical provider. Washing alone is insufficient. Do not wait for symptoms, the end of visits or the end of duty. Absence of symptoms does not establish safety.

A qualified provider decides assessment and any treatment. Do not choose medication from supplies. In the simulation, state and point out the reporting and evaluation pathway; there is no actual puncture or medication use.

heading_fil: Ipakita sa trainer ang ligtas na kilos
heading_en: Show safe actions to the trainer
display_fil: Dummy equipment; puwesto at fill line; trainer-approved hand hygiene at PPE. Trainer ang titingin sa kilos.
display_en: Dummy equipment; position and fill line; trainer-approved hand hygiene and PPE. The trainer observes actions.
narration_fil:
“Dummy equipment lamang,” paalala ng trainer kay Apple. Bago magsimula, tiyakin na walang tunay na karayom, used sharps, body fluid o kemikal sa station. Ipakita ang puwesto ng dummy sharps container at ang fill line nito ayon sa aprubadong checklist at tagubilin para sa container. Ituro kung kailan kailangang palitan ang box; huwag mag-imbento ng pangkalahatang fill level o hawakan ang laman.

Ipakita ang hand hygiene at paggamit at pagtanggal ng PPE ayon lamang sa trainer-approved local protocol. Hindi kapalit ng hand hygiene ang gloves. Kung hindi pa nasusuri ang checklist o hindi alam ang kailangang PPE, ihinto muna ang demo at magtanong sa awtorisadong trainer. Hindi tayo mag-iimbento ng PPE sequence. Ayusin ang upuan at bag para sa komportableng posisyon; walang masakit na stretching.

Titingnan ng trainer ang mismong kilos ni Apple at itatala ang bawat critical step na nakita, na-prompt o hindi pa ligtas. Ang pagsagot sa quiz o panonood ng kuwento ay hindi katibayan na naipakita ang ligtas na gawain.
narration_en:
“Dummy equipment only,” the trainer reminds Apple. Before starting, confirm that the station has no real needles, used sharps, body fluids or chemicals. Show the dummy sharps container’s position and its fill line according to the approved checklist and container instructions. Point out when the box needs replacement; do not invent a universal fill level or touch its contents.

Demonstrate hand hygiene and PPE use and removal only under the trainer-approved local protocol. Gloves do not replace hand hygiene. If the checklist has not been reviewed or the required PPE is unknown, pause the demonstration and ask the authorized trainer. Do not invent a PPE sequence. Adjust the chair and bag for a comfortable position; no painful stretching.

The trainer watches Apple’s actual actions and records each critical step seen, prompted or not yet safe. Answering a quiz or watching a story does not establish demonstrated safe performance.

display_fil: Hazard, oras, lugar, aktuwal na kontrol at hindi pa alam. Near miss ≠ exposure; kumpirmahin ang benepisyo.
display_en: Hazard, time, place, actual control and unknowns. Near miss ≠ exposure; confirm benefits.
narration_fil:
Sa kathang-isip na practice, muntik madulas si Apple sa basa at walang nasaktan. Sabi niya sa kunwaring contact, “Alas-diyes sa demo station, may basang bahagi ng daanan. Muntik akong madulas. Itinigil ko ang pagdaan doon at ipinaalam ko sa trainer; hindi pa kumpirmado ang susunod na kontrol.” Mga detalye ito ng practice, hindi tala ng totoong pasyente o patakaran ng barangay.

Itala ang hazard, oras, lugar at kontrol na talagang ginawa; sabihin kung ano ang hindi pa alam. Gamitin ang lokal na near-miss process at humingi ng awtorisadong pasya sa correction at muling pagsisimula. Ang near miss na walang injury o exposure ay iba sa needlestick exposure. Kung may exposure, agarang reporting at medical evaluation ang kailangan; hindi sapat ang near-miss form.

Sa tunay na insidente, ihanda ang available na impormasyon para sa referral at anumang naaangkop na benefits process pagkatapos unahin ang pangangalaga. Hindi pare-pareho ang insurance at benepisyo ng BHW. Kumpirmahin sa coordinator kung ano ang naaangkop; huwag mangako ng coverage.
narration_en:
In fictional practice, Apple nearly slips on a wet area and nobody is hurt. She tells the simulated contact, “At ten o’clock at the demonstration station, part of the walkway was wet. I nearly slipped. I stopped using that route and told the trainer; the next control is not yet confirmed.” These are practice details, not an actual patient record or barangay policy.

Record the hazard, time, place and control actually taken; state what remains unknown. Use the local near-miss process and obtain an authorized decision about correction and resuming work. A near miss without injury or exposure differs from a needlestick exposure. Exposure requires immediate reporting and medical evaluation; a near-miss form alone is insufficient.

After an actual incident, prepare available information for referral and any applicable benefits process after prioritizing care. BHW insurance and benefits differ. Confirm applicable arrangements with the coordinator; do not promise coverage.

display_fil: Kumpirmahin ang contact, backup at evaluation route. Agaran ang pangangalaga; kasunod ang documentation.
display_en: Confirm contact, backup and evaluation route. Immediate care; documentation follows.
narration_fil:
Tanong ni Apple, “Sino ang tatanggap ng report at paano ako makakakuha agad ng medical evaluation?” Bago ang duty, kumpirmahin sa awtorisadong trainer o supervisor ang contact, backup kung hindi maabot, at ruta sa kwalipikadong medical provider ayon sa lokal na proseso. Huwag mag-imbento ng pangalan, emergency number, partner agreement o oras ng serbisyo. Kung hindi pa kumpirmado, isulat na hindi pa alam at humingi ng paglilinaw.

Sa simulated exposure, sabihin ang unang hakbang, i-report agad ang pangyayari at ipakita kung paano inaayos ang agarang evaluation. Magkahiwalay ang agarang pangangalaga at susunod na documentation: hindi kailangang matapos muna ang administrative form bago humingi ng pagsusuri. Hindi dahilan para maghintay ang kawalan ng sintomas.

Ihanda pagkatapos ang kaugnay na incident details ayon sa lokal na proseso. Ang reporting contact ang tumutulong sa pag-aayos ng evaluation pathway; ang kwalipikadong provider ang nagpapasya sa assessment at paggamot. Hindi natin ipagpapalagay na tapos na ang medical care o ligtas na bumalik sa trabaho.
narration_en:
Apple asks, “Who receives the report, and how do I obtain immediate medical evaluation?” Before duty, confirm with the authorized trainer or supervisor the contact, backup if unreachable, and route to a qualified medical provider under the local process. Do not invent names, emergency numbers, partner agreements or service hours. Mark unconfirmed information as unknown and seek clarification.

For simulated exposure, state the first action, report the event immediately and show how immediate evaluation is arranged. Keep immediate care separate from later documentation: an administrative form does not need to be completed before seeking evaluation. Having no symptoms is no reason to wait.

Prepare relevant incident details afterward through the local process. The reporting contact helps arrange the evaluation pathway; the qualified provider decides assessment and treatment. Do not assume medical care is complete or that returning to work is safe.

display_fil: Tatlong role → attempt → tiyak na feedback → ligtas na retry. Hindi naobserbahan ≠ passed.
display_en: Three roles → attempt → specific feedback → safe retry. Not observed ≠ passed.
narration_fil:
Sa triad, magpalitan bilang demonstrator, kunwaring reporting contact at observer. Gamitin ang aprubadong dummy-equipment checklist at scenario card. Ipakita ang container placement at replacement cue, trainer-approved hand hygiene at PPE, at simulated exposure response. Sabihin, “Huhugasan ko ng sabon at tubig, mag-uulat agad at kukuha kaagad ng medical evaluation; hindi ko hihintayin ang sintomas o forms.” Kumpirmahin ang contact at ruta; sabihin nang tapat kung hindi pa alam.

Itatala ng observer ang eksaktong kilos o sinabi, hindi “magaling” lamang. Kung may unsafe step o pag-antala, sabihin ang “Pause,” itigil ang simulation, ipaliwanag ang isang tiyak na kailangang itama at ulitin ang hakbang nang ligtas. Walang tunay na sharps, kemikal o body fluids. Magbigay ng feedback at pagkakataong mag-retry sa bawat role rotation.

Peer practice lamang ang triad attempt na hindi nakita ng trainer. Itala iyon bilang “hindi naobserbahan,” hindi passed. Kung mag-isa, mag-paper o spoken rehearsal ng reporting; kailangan pa rin ng aktuwal na trainer observation para sa physical demonstration. Bago ang duty, kumpirmahin ang immediate evaluation pathway at mga patakaran sa pause at resume.
narration_en:
In a triad, rotate as demonstrator, simulated reporting contact and observer. Use the approved dummy-equipment checklist and scenario card. Show container placement and the replacement cue, trainer-approved hand hygiene and PPE, and the simulated exposure response. Say, “I will wash with soap and water, report immediately and obtain immediate medical evaluation; I will not wait for symptoms or forms.” Confirm the contact and route; honestly state what remains unknown.

The observer records the exact action or words, rather than just “good.” If there is an unsafe step or delay, say “Pause,” stop the simulation, explain one specific correction and retry the step safely. No real sharps, chemicals or body fluids. Give feedback and a retry opportunity in every role rotation.

A triad attempt unseen by the trainer is peer practice only. Record it as “not observed,” not passed. Alone, use a paper or spoken reporting rehearsal; physical demonstration still requires actual trainer observation. Before duty, confirm the immediate evaluation pathway and pause and resume procedures.

display_fil: Piliin, ipaliwanag, saka ihambing sa naobserbahang practice.
display_en: Choose, explain, then compare with observed practice.

check.prompt_fil: Natusok si Apple ng used needle ngunit walang sintomas. Ano ang gagawin?
check.prompt_en: Apple has a used-needle injury but no symptoms. What should she do?

options.fil: Hugasan, iulat agad at magpa-medical evaluation kaagad.
options.en: Wash, report immediately and obtain immediate medical evaluation.

options.fil: Hugasan at maghintay hanggang matapos ang visits.
options.en: Wash and wait until the visits are finished.

options.fil: Pumili ng gamot mula sa available supplies.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang sagot ang tamang sequence. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang; maaaring maantala ng paghihintay ang time-critical na assessment at treatment. Qualified provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot. 1. Tama: hugasan, iulat agad at magpa-evaluation kaagad. Ang kwalipikadong provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot. 2. Hindi ligtas ang paghihintay hanggang matapos ang visits. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas; kailangan agad ang reporting at evaluation. 3. Huwag pumili ng gamot mula sa supplies. Kwalipikadong medical provider ang magpapasya sa assessment at paggamot. Sa kathang-isip na simulation, ipinakita ni Apple sa trainer ang ligtas na dummy demonstration at agarang reporting at evaluation pathway. Kasunod ng pangangalaga ang documentation. Walang ipinapalagay na paggamot o medical outcome.
check.feedback_en: The first response follows the required sequence. Washing alone is insufficient; waiting can delay time-critical assessment and treatment. A qualified provider decides treatment. 1. Correct: wash, report immediately and obtain immediate evaluation. A qualified provider decides treatment. 2. Waiting until visits end is unsafe. Washing alone is insufficient; reporting and evaluation are needed immediately. 3. Do not choose medication from supplies. A qualified medical provider decides assessment and treatment. In the fictional simulation, Apple shows the trainer a safe dummy demonstration and immediate reporting and evaluation pathway. Documentation follows care. No treatment or medical outcome is assumed.

narration_fil:
Sa larawan ng kunwaring practice, naghahanda si Apple na mag-report; walang tunay na sugat o karayom. Basahin ang tanong at piliin ang susunod na hakbang. Ipaliwanag muna kung bakit bago tingnan ang feedback. Ang kawalan ng sintomas ay hindi patunay ng kaligtasan. Ihambing pagkatapos ang paliwanag sa sariling practice attempt.

Hindi katibayan ng observed competence ang pag-click sa tamang sagot. Kailangan pa rin ang trainer-observed dummy demonstration at ligtas na reporting at evaluation response.
narration_en:
In the simulated practice picture, Apple prepares to report; there is no real wound or needle. Read the question and choose the next step. Explain why before viewing feedback. Absence of symptoms does not establish safety. Then compare the explanation with your practice attempt.

Clicking the correct answer is not evidence of observed competence. A trainer-observed dummy demonstration and safe reporting and evaluation response are still required.
